summary: Learn change control and scope management with practical tools, impact analysis, and governance templates. Build skills for real project delivery.
lede: Change control and scope management covers how project teams assess proposed changes and keep scope, schedule, cost and quality aligned with approved baselines. For project managers, PMO analysts and project controls professionals, it offers practical methods to triage requests, assess impacts and record decisions through governance workflows. Learners also practise verifying deliverables against acceptance criteria and preparing change reports with traceable approvals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage project delivery, governance, and scope change decisions. It is most relevant when your role depends on keeping baselines credible while responding to real-world change pressure.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with project documents such as a scope statement, WBS, schedule extract, risk log, and change request form. Spreadsheet use is helpful for impact calculation, and optional familiarity with Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 will support the scheduling exercises.
